'''Payne''' is a male tourist NPC from Ragunna in [[Capitoline Hill City]].

{{Dialogue Start}}
==Dialogue==
;A gladiatorial fight is in progress. Please watch out and keep your distance.
;They seem to have gotten into an argument over whether sparkling water tastes good and challenged each other to a fight.
;But, please, don't worry. These two Gladiators submitted a duel application through the proper channels.
;We will ensure the fight proceeds smoothly and everyone stays safe. 

;You sunless cur! Do you have the guts to fight me?

;Alright! Draw your weapon. Ten, nine, eight... three, two, one!

;Now? Fine! The patrol guard's here to officiate. Come at me!

;'''Payne''' Fight! Fight! Fight! Fight!

;(Day)
:'''Payne''' 
:Fight! Fight! Woohoo! Did you see that? Amazing!
:They can say exactly what's on their minds, then stand their ground and duke it out!
:It's so cool! This is way more fun than Ragunna!
:I've already made my mind. I'm staying here to watch the next Agon of Champions.
:I'm going to really take in this city of honor and enjoy each contest of bravery!
{{Dialogue End}}
